question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
SELECT 
    MIN(customer_profit) as overall_min_profit,
    MAX(customer_profit) as overall_max_profit
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_id,
        SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) as customer_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770 
        AND t.calendar_month_desc = '2021-12'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
)
